sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate faithfully encodes the required case-specific capacity path or the cross-owner association between each load case, application location, and the ship's identified ice-load patch.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove sh:minCount 1 from the ship's nltl:hasStructuralMember property: the requirement imposes a universal design rule on applicable web frames and load-carrying stringers, but does not independently require the ship to represent at least one structural member.
